Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 가위에 눌렸을 때 세이라에게 도움을 받았다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: When I was paralyzed in my sleep, Seira appeared and helped me.

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 被鬼压床时，得到了赛拉的帮助。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 被鬼壓床時，得到了賽拉的幫助。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Quand j'ai eu une paralysie du sommeil, Seira m'a apporté son aide.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Als ich Schlafparalyse hatte, half mir Seira.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Cuando me atraparon con la tijera, Seira me ayudó.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Quando tive paralisia do sono, Seira me ajudou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ตอนที่โดนผีอำ เซร่าก็มาช่วยเอาไว้ค่ะ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Saat aku ketindihan, Seira datang dan membantuku.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Khi bị bóng đè, tôi đã được Seira giúp đỡ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: जब मैं नींद में लकवाग्रस्त था, तो सेइरा ने मेरी मदद की।
